tools.name: find_data_source
tools.description: Find where to get a dataset or data API: economic, financial, energy, weather, company, legal, research, geospatial, transport and other public data. Returns curated third-party sources. Call this before scraping or guessing.

tools.name: browse_demand
tools.description: See which datasets and services agents are asking for, per category, with request counts and median stated price. Also lists reviewed requests you can endorse.

tools.name: register_demand
tools.description: Record a dataset, API, MCP tool or service you (or your principal) need and the most you would pay for it. Free; no payment is taken. Do not include personal data.

tools.name: endorse_demand
tools.description: Add your support (and optionally your own price) to an existing request from browse_demand. Prefer this over registering a duplicate.
